description_en: Queries the logs of an IPsec server
description_zh: 调用ListIpsecServerLogs接口查看IPsec服务端日志
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-ipsec-server-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipsec-server-id iss-2zei2n5q5zhirfh730000 --from 1671003744 --to 1671004344 --minute-period 10 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpsecServerLogs

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the region where the IPsec server is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.
parameters.description_zh:
IPsec服务端所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the IPsec server is created.

parameters.description_en: The ID of the IPsec server.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec server
parameters.name: ipsec_server_id

parameters.description_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value must be a UNIX timestamp. For example, 1671003744 specifies 15:42:24 (UTC+8) on December 14, 2022.

>  If you specify **From**, you must also specify **To** or **MinutePeriod**.
parameters.description_zh:
日志起始时间，仅支持传入UNIX秒级时间戳，例如1671003744，1671003744表示的时间为2022年12月14日15:42:24。

> 如果指定**From**，则必须指定**To**或**MinutePeriod**。

parameters.description_en:

>  If you specify **To**, you must also specify **From** or **MinutePeriod**.
parameters.description_zh:

parameters.name: to

parameters.description_en:
The interval at which log data is queried. Valid values: **1** to **10**. Unit: minutes.

>  If both **From** and **To** are not specified, you must specify **MinutePeriod**.
parameters.description_zh:
日志周期。取值范围：**1**~**10**。单位：分钟。

> 如果不指定**From**和**To**，则必须指定**MinutePeriod**。
